verdict.rationale: Stripe explicitly documents Machine Payment Protocol (MPP) and x402 for monetizing APIs: servers return HTTP 402 with payment details, agents present credentials and retry, with no checkout UI involved, plus a conformance CLI (mppx validate) and minimums as low as $0.01 in stablecoins. This is well-documented first-party with a one-prompt build path and CLI tooling for agent test-payments. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer reports of production usage at scale, and community commentary notes docs on MPP end-to-end object semantics are 'sparse' which slightly limits confidence in completeness.
